proposals.reason: The official current flame artwork differs from the accepted base icon: the official flame uses brand red #EC0000 with the current curve geometry (official Illustrator-exported site asset), while the base uses #ea1d25 and proportionally different control points. The brand guide sanctions the flame alone as the app-pictogram variant, and the flame is selectable from the official positive-logo SVG without tracing.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Genuine original vector artwork identical to the bank's own current logo asset (clean Illustrator serialization; the official DAM URL's DOCTYPE/entities prolog is rejected by the SVG safety gate); the flame subpath preserves the current official geometry and brand red #EC0000, correcting both the base icon's outdated fill (#ea1d25) and its divergent curve drawing.

sources.observation: Clean-serialization copy of the same official artwork (Illustrator 22 export comment, docname Banco_Santander..., 4461 bytes, sha256 3ecfff6429bc48679ac68adebd64b31beaefa96cc9563f14f04d5600c14c1f4c, viewBox 0 0 238.2 41.5, no DOCTYPE/entities): flame + wordmark in one path, 6 subpaths, flame leading. Bound as candidate source because the official serialization carries an XML DOCTYPE/entities prolog that the SVG safety gate rejects; flame subpath extracted verbatim and verified to render identically to the official asset's flame.

Current official logo SVG served on santander.com: flame + Santander wordmark in one path, fill #EC0000, Illustrator export (sha256 45cb5f772b92c232f84d2369c663155fb401710fc4b4fcbdf864118e0bef5481). Flame is the leading subpath spanning x 0.001–35.352, y 1.464–35.0; selectable verbatim without tracing.

Official brand guide (Basic guidelines, 2020, 13 pp, vector PDF): the flame is the brand symbol; the symbol alone is used in small spaces such as the app pictogram; brand red is PMS 485 C / HEX #EC0000; official artwork ships as AI/EPS/PDF/JPG/PNG (no SVG download).
Official media resources page references the logo DAM assets; favicons are raster PNG only; no standalone flame SVG is published for download.
